en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn, from Al Qasim Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Do not eat with the left hand and you are able (to eat with the right)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ahmad ibn Muhammad has narrated from al-Husayn, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn abu Hamzah from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Do not eat with your left hand if you can.’”
